subject: Music Production
title: NFTs and Sample Ownership
description: A quick, practical guide to NFTs and Sample Ownership.

hook.text: Some artists have sold samples as NFTs, granting buyers exclusive rights to use them in music.

buildup.text: Blockchain technology creates a verifiable record of who owns and has licensed a specific sample.

discovery.text: This could automate royalty splits and clearance, removing lawyers from the sampling process.

twist.text: Most NFT music ventures have struggled commercially, and the technology remains largely unproven.

climax.text: Whether blockchain fixes sampling's legal problems remains one of the music industry's open questions.

punchline.text: Blockchain promises to fix sampling rights, but hasn't yet.

quiz.question: What potential benefit could blockchain bring to sampling?
